The subject received only five ordered JPEG samples plus neutral timing facts and
an opaque identifier. It did not receive the semantic clip ID, title, target,
transcript, MP4, or audio. Judge only claims observable across those still frames.
Ignore every audio line in the reference and require empty audio fields; do not
reward a claim of silence. Accept semantically equivalent visual wording, but
require concrete frame-grounded evidence at submitted sample times. Penalize
invented actions, edits, camera movement, continuity changes, identities, props,
locations, or story meaning that the ordered samples do not show.
Pass only at score >= 0.8.

Source-verified interpretation boundaries: frame indexes are zero-based. Bedside lamp/bed or abstract figure/barrier readings are permitted. Dialogue bodies enlarge while prop/background do not scale, so no camera mechanism is required. In prop-swap indexes0-1 are red and2-4 blue; generic blue is absent from allowed color_tags, so correct blue text suffices. Evidence requires2-4 grounded entries, not coverage of all5 frames. Do not invent tag requirements outside the frozen reference/enum.

Background is blue/navy. Camera mechanism is excluded from this case's scoring: do not reward or penalize static versus inferred push-in as a verified camera mechanism. The observable figure enlargement is required regardless of that excluded mechanism. Subjective tone labels should be reported as interpretive disagreement, not a factual source contradiction. Preserve the maintained rubric and score scale.
